2. (40 min) Compare hip roll and knee torques with Day 108; write the % difference for each.
3. (30 min) Save model hash (`sha256sum model/baymax.xml`), timestep, seed and the replay command in logs/baseline_R0_3.md.
Calculation or measurement: Difference % = (model − hand) / hand × 100 for hip roll and knee.
Completion checks:
Differences over 15% are explained or logged as REWORK.
Replay command reproduces the numbers.
Hashes saved.

Title: Define the standing reference case
Goal: A single file that fully defines the quiet-standing test.
Steps:
1. (40 min) Write tests/cases/stand_ref.json: initial angles (knees 0.3 rad, ankles −0.15 rad, hips −0.15 rad), duration 10 s, timestep 0.002 s, tether slack 20 mm.
2. (40 min) List outcome metrics: CoM horizontal drift (m), peak and RMS torque per joint (N m), time in saturation (s), mean tether force (N).
3. (20 min) Add analysis-only pass criteria: drift ≤ 0.02 m, saturation 0 s, tether force 0 N.
Completion checks:
The case runs from the JSON alone.
All four metrics defined with units.
Criteria labelled analysis-only.

Title: Implement a bounded standing controller
Goal: A joint PD controller with gravity compensation that never exceeds the drive limits.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Write controllers/stand.py: τ = Kp(q* − q) − Kd·q̇ + g(q), with g(q) from mj_inverse at the target pose; clip τ to each actuator's range.
2. (40 min) Put Kp and Kd per joint in params/stand_gains.json (start Kp = 300 N m/rad, Kd = 15 N m s/rad).
3. (30 min) Log commanded vs applied torque and count clipped samples per joint.
Calculation or measurement: Clipped samples / total samples per joint.
Completion checks:
Gains live only in the params file.
Clipping is counted and logged.
No torque above the actuator range is applied.

Title: Run the first standing cases
Goal: Two logged standing runs with honest outcomes.
Steps:
1. (40 min) Run stand_ref and a copy with the pelvis 0.02 m forward at the start.
2. (40 min) Save joint states, contact forces, CoM, torques and tether force as CSV with run IDs SIM-STAND-01 and -02.
3. (20 min) Write one line per run: stood / fell / saturated, and when.
Completion checks:
Both runs have IDs and full logs.
A fall or saturation is written down, not re-run away.
Each run replays identically.

Title: Inspect static load and saturation
Goal: Explain every difference between simulated and hand-calculated standing torque.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Tabulate RMS torque per joint from SIM-STAND-01 against the Day 108 static screen.
2. (40 min) Flag any joint above its rated torque (40 N m direct, 76 at 2:1, 114 at 3:1) for more than 1 s, and any non-zero tether force.
3. (20 min) Write the likely cause for each flag (posture, gains, mass error).
Completion checks:
Every joint has a model vs hand value.
Over-rated joints flagged.
Tether help disclosed.

Title: Sweep mass and COM assumptions
Goal: Find which mass assumptions decide whether standing works.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Run stand_ref at total mass 50, 55 and 60 kg (scale the torso) and with the torso CoM moved ±30 mm forward and sideways.
2. (40 min) Record outcome, hip-roll RMS and knee RMS for each of the 7 cases in sweeps/stand_mass.csv.
3. (20 min) Mark each assumption that moves knee or hip-roll RMS by more than 10%.
Completion checks:
7 cases logged.
Sensitive assumptions named.
The reference case is untouched.

Title: Check standing numerical convergence
Goal: Show the standing result does not depend on the timestep.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Rerun SIM-STAND-01 at timestep 0.001 s and 0.0005 s.
2. (40 min) Compare peak knee torque and CoM drift across the three timesteps.
3. (20 min) Accept if the change from 0.002 to 0.001 s is under 5% (analysis choice; record it).
Completion checks:
All three timesteps reported.
Δ% stated against the 5% choice.
The chosen timestep written into stand_ref.json.

Title: Review standing evidence
Goal: A replayable standing packet with bounded conclusions.
Steps:
1. (40 min) Write the review: model hash, controller version, runs, sweeps, convergence, failures.
2. (40 min) State conclusions one line each, e.g. 'stands 10 s at 55 ± 5 kg with knee RMS ≤ X N m in this model'.
3. (20 min) Export a website backup (Settings → Export progress JSON) into JacobsBaymax/evidence/backups/.
Completion checks:
The exact model and controller are identified.
Every claim has a run ID.
Physical standing remains untested.

Title: Define the weight shift trajectory
Goal: A timed side-to-side shift that keeps both soles flat.
Steps:
1. (40 min) Write tests/cases/shift_ref.json: pelvis moves 0.10 m toward the left foot over 2.0 s (cosine profile), holds 1.0 s, returns over 2.0 s.
2. (40 min) Compute the expected stance-foot load at full shift and write it in the case file.
3. (20 min) Set tether slack 20 mm; any tether force will be reported as assistance.
Calculation or measurement: Left-foot load at full shift ≈ 539.55 × (0.17 + 0.10)/0.34 ≈ 428 N (static estimate).
Completion checks:
Trajectory fully timed.
Expected load stated with working.
Within joint envelopes.

Title: Implement bounded weight shift tracking
Goal: Track the shift with inverse kinematics that keep the feet flat.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Add IK to controllers/shift.py: for lateral shift y, hip roll = −asin(y/L) and ankle roll = +asin(y/L) per leg, L = hip-to-ankle length.
2. (40 min) Reuse the standing PD + gravity terms and the same clipping.
3. (20 min) Log foot roll relative to the floor; it should stay within ±0.01 rad.
Completion checks:
Foot roll within ±0.01 rad.
Same clipping as standing.
Run replays identically.

Title: Run left and right shifts
Goal: Mirror runs that expose sign errors.
Steps:
1. (40 min) Run SIM-SHIFT-L and SIM-SHIFT-R with identical settings.
2. (40 min) Compare peak hip-roll and ankle-roll torques and stance-foot load.
3. (30 min) Investigate any left/right difference over 5% by checking axis signs in the register.
Completion checks:
Both runs logged.
Asymmetry ≤ 5% or explained.
Axis signs confirmed.

Title: Inspect contact and sole behavior
Goal: Make sure soft contact or friction is not faking success.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Plot stance-foot CoP during the shift and measure its closest distance to the sole edge.
2. (40 min) Check for corner lift-off (contact force < 5 N) and slip (> 2 mm).
3. (20 min) Write the contact settings used next to the results.
Completion checks:
Edge margin reported.
Lift-off and slip checked.
Contact settings cited.

Title: Sweep friction and sensor delay
Goal: See how the shift behaves with worse floors and slower sensors.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Run the left shift at μ = 0.3, 0.5, 0.7 and with sensor delay 0, 10, 20 ms, one change at a time.
2. (40 min) Record success, slip, saturation and tether force in sweeps/shift.csv.
3. (20 min) Record peak stance-foot yaw moment and compare with the 28.2 N m Day 6 friction screen.
Calculation or measurement: 6 cases; yaw margin = 28.2 − peak yaw (N m) at μ = 0.5.
Completion checks:
Each case has its exact values.
Yaw margin recorded.
Reference run untouched.

Title: Inject a blocked transition
Goal: See what the controller does when a foot sensor drops out mid-shift.
Steps:
1. (50 min) At t = 1.0 s mark the left foot-force signal stale. The controller should enter STOP_LATCHED.
2. (40 min) Log detection time and what the model robot and tether do over the next 3 s.
3. (20 min) Link the result to its hazard ID.
Completion checks:
Detection time logged, or the failure recorded.
Post-stop behaviour described.
Hazard linked.

Title: Review weight shifting readiness
Goal: Decide whether the shift is good enough to build steps on.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Write the passing parameter region (μ, delay, mass) and the failures.
2. (40 min) Optionally send the packet to a controls reviewer for 30 minutes of comments.
3. (20 min) Export a website backup (Settings → Export progress JSON) into JacobsBaymax/evidence/backups/.
Calculation or measurement: Passing region as μ and delay ranges.
Completion checks:
Every claim has a run ID.
Failures listed.
Decision written: proceed or rework.
Outside help: Optional: a controls engineer. Get: written notes with name and date.

Title: Define step and speed measurements
Goal: Rules that count steps and compute speed the same way in simulation and on hardware.
Steps:
1. (40 min) Define events: toe-off = foot force < 5% body weight; landing = first contact; stable contact = foot force ≥ 80% of expected for 0.2 s.
2. (40 min) Define speed: pelvis x displacement between first toe-off and third stable landing, divided by that time.
3. (20 min) Report start-up before the first toe-off and settling after the third landing separately.
Completion checks:
Each event has a numeric threshold.
The speed formula is fixed.
The same file is used for hardware Days 281–291.

Title: Create one swing foot trajectory
Goal: A low, smooth swing the legs can follow.
Steps:
1. (40 min) Define swing: step length 0.144 m, peak lift 0.03 m, duration 0.6 s, quintic profile (zero speed and acceleration at both ends).
2. (40 min) Solve leg IK along the swing; record peak joint speed and acceleration for all 5 joints.
3. (20 min) Check sole clearance stays > 0.01 m mid-swing and no Day 97 collision is hit.
Completion checks:
Peak joint speeds tabulated.
Clearance > 0.01 m.
No known collision.

Title: Run one simulated step
Goal: One logged step driven by a ZMP plan, not by the tether.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Implement ZMP preview control (Kajita et al., 2003) with the cart-table model at CoM height 1.0 m; generate the CoM path for one step.
2. (40 min) Run stand → shift → swing → land; save contacts, pelvis x, joint torques and tether force as SIM-STEP-01.
3. (30 min) Check tether force during swing against the analysis target of 27 N (5% of weight).
Completion checks:
The step is visible in contact logs.
Tether force reported.
Failed attempts kept.

Title: Chain three alternating steps
Goal: L-R-L stepping with explicit hand-overs.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Extend the ZMP plan to three steps; hand over only when the landing foot reaches stable contact (Day 162 rule).
2. (40 min) Log each transition time and any limit or fault event.
3. (20 min) Define the reset pose and settle time between trials.
Completion checks:
Six events logged.
Transitions follow the Day 162 rule.
Reset defined.

Title: Run two separate simulated trials
Goal: Two independent three-step trials with speed measured by the fixed rule.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Run SIM-3STEP-T1 and -T2 from the reset pose.
2. (40 min) Compute speed per trial and peak and RMS torque per joint.
3. (20 min) Write each trial's result separately: steps completed, speed, max tether force.
Completion checks:
Each trial reported on its own.
Model, controller and case hashes saved.
Slower or failed trials reported as such.

Title: Inspect gait feasibility conflicts
Goal: Find joints that need more torque or cooling than the chosen drives give.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Compare each joint's RMS and peak with the drive's rated and peak (direct, 2:1 or 3:1).
2. (40 min) For any joint over rated RMS, rerun with a 1.5 s step period and note the change.
3. (20 min) List remaining conflicts with a proposed fix (ratio, posture, hip spacing).
Calculation or measurement: Margin = rated − RMS (N m) per joint.
Completion checks:
All 10 joints have margins.
Slower-step effect measured.
Conflicts have proposed fixes.

Title: Review simulated gait evidence
Goal: A gait packet ready for outside comments.
Steps:

2. (40 min) Send it to a controls or robotics engineer with three questions: is the ZMP plan sound, are the margins enough, what would you change?
3. (20 min) Export a website backup (Settings → Export progress JSON) into JacobsBaymax/evidence/backups/.
Completion checks:
Assumptions and tether help disclosed.
Review request recorded.
No claim that the robot walked.
Outside help: A controls or robotics engineer. Get: written answers to the three questions, with name and date.

Title: Create the bounded sweep matrix
Goal: Plan every uncertainty case before running any.

3. (20 min) Define the outcome: three steps without tether force > 27 N and without saturation > 0.2 s.
Completion checks:

Range sources cited.

Calculation or measurement: Worst hip-roll RMS vs 114 N m (3:1).
Completion checks:

Worst case identified.
Failures kept.

Title: Run contact sensitivity
Goal: Robustness across friction and backlash.
Steps:
1. (60 min) Run the μ and backlash cases.
2. (40 min) Where the outcome flips, rerun at half timestep to check it is physical, not numerical.
3. (20 min) Record peak yaw moment for each μ against μ × 539.55 × 0.104 N m.
Calculation or measurement: Yaw capacity at μ = 0.3: 16.8 N m; at 0.7: 39.4 N m.
Completion checks:
Each claim backed by a run.

Yaw recorded.

Title: Inject sensing and communication faults
Goal: Map each sensor or comms fault to a hazard and a detection time.
Steps:

2. (40 min) Record detection time, the state entered and the tether load afterwards.
3. (20 min) Link each to its hazard ID and Day 132 fault case.
Completion checks:
Each fault mapped to a hazard.

Tether load recorded.

Title: Inject saturation and restart faults
Goal: Show restarts never resume motion and missing limits block motion.
Steps:
1. (60 min) Run: torque limit cut to 80%, limits file missing, limits hash wrong, controller restart mid-step, stale step request.
2. (40 min) Check the state machine ends in DISABLED or STOP_LATCHED for each.
3. (20 min) Save logs with case IDs.
Completion checks:
No case resumes motion by itself.
Missing or bad limits block enable.
Logs saved.

Title: Reconcile simulation and sizing
Goal: Give every joint a clear technical status for procurement.
Steps:
1. (60 min) For each joint put hand screen, simulated worst RMS and peak, and the drive's rated and peak side by side.
2. (40 min) Mark each joint OK / marginal (< 15% margin) / fails, with the fix for marginal and failing joints.
3. (20 min) Update the D-03 notes in revision_history/decision_log_R0_3.csv.
Completion checks:

Decision log updated.

Goal: Close the simulation phase with conclusions you can defend.
Steps:

2. (40 min) Add simulation evidence references to JB-V-04 and JB-V-05 in the working verification matrix, labelled analysis only.
3. (20 min) Export a website backup (Settings → Export progress JSON) into JacobsBaymax/evidence/backups/.
Completion checks:

Title: Audit mechanical interfaces
Goal: One consistent set of mechanical interfaces across CAD and tables.

Completion checks:

Mismatches recorded.

Calculation or measurement: Signals listed; components in the e-stop path.
Completion checks:

3. (20 min) Update D-01, D-03 and D-04 in the decision log.
Calculation or measurement: Δ mass and Δ cost vs Day 6.
Completion checks:

Title: Produce the one leg fixture drawings
Goal: A fixture that holds a leg and takes its loads without anyone holding it.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Design a frame bolted to a bench or floor that clamps the pelvis plate, with a lever arm and weight hanger for load tests.
2. (40 min) Size the frame for the largest test torque (hip roll 80.9 N m static) with the reviewer's margin.
3. (20 min) Add inspection notes: bolt torques and joint checks.
Calculation or measurement: 80.9 N m at 0.5 m = 161.8 N ≈ 16.5 kg on the hanger.
Completion checks:
No hand-held step.
Lever and loads defined.
Inspection notes on the drawing.

Title: Produce supported handling fixture drawings
Goal: Drawings for the handling stand, tray and robot-secure frame.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Draw the floor stand with the bought actuator, a tray with a retaining lip and pin, and a catch tray below.
2. (40 min) Check tip-over: base half-width must exceed overturning moment / stand weight.
3. (20 min) Draw the frame that secures the robot during handling.
Calculation or measurement: Overturning ≈ 24.5 N × 0.30 m = 7.35 N m; a 10 kg stand needs half-width > 7.35 / 98.1 = 0.075 m before margin.
Completion checks:
Tip-over check on the drawing.
Retention shown.
Robot-secure frame drawn.

Title: Build fabrication and incoming inspection plans
Goal: What to check before any part is used.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Per part: material certificate, 3 critical dimensions, fit check, mass.
2. (40 min) List tools (calipers, scale, thread gauges) and which you own.
3. (20 min) Write the quarantine rule: tagged, bagged, logged.
Completion checks:
Every part has checks.
Tools available or listed.
Quarantine defined.

Title: Review fabrication readiness
Goal: Drawings, reviews, parts and shop agree.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Cross-check drawing revisions against the reviewer's sign-off and the quotes.
2. (40 min) Send the package to the chosen shop for manufacturability comments.
3. (20 min) Export a website backup (Settings → Export progress JSON) into JacobsBaymax/evidence/backups/.
Completion checks:
Only reviewed revisions in the package.
Shop comments logged.
G4 still pending.

Title: Assemble the G4 release packet
Goal: Everything a fabrication release needs, in one place.
Steps:
1. (50 min) List drawing revisions, materials, shop, processes and inspection hold points.
2. (40 min) Attach the owner's cost approval and the structural sign-off.
3. (20 min) List anything missing as a blocker.
Completion checks:
Every prerequisite evidenced or BLOCKED.
Hold points listed.
Cost approval attached.

Title: Conduct the fabrication release review
Goal: A real G4 decision for specific parts.
Steps:
1. (60 min) Review the packet with the structural reviewer and the shop.
2. (40 min) Record which parts are released and any conditions.
3. (20 min) Enter G4 on the website from that record.
Completion checks:
Release names parts and revisions.
Conditions recorded.
Gate entered from the record.
Outside help: Reviewer from Day 199 and the chosen shop.

Title: Coordinate the released fabrication work
Goal: The shop builds exactly the released revision.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Send the controlled package and get written acknowledgment of revision and quantities.
2. (40 min) Answer shop questions in writing and log every change request.
3. (20 min) Refuse substitutions that have not been re-reviewed.
Completion checks:
Acknowledgment saved.
Changes logged.
No unreviewed substitution.

Title: Track vendor and shop delivery
Goal: Know what is late and which stage it delays.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Update promised and actual dates for every order.
2. (40 min) For each late item, write which stage (S2–S16) it delays and by how many days.
3. (20 min) Plan desk or software work for the waiting time.
Calculation or measurement: Days late per item; stage delay.
Completion checks:
Every order has a status.
Stage impact written.
Waiting time planned.

Title: Inspect received commercial components
Goal: Accept only correct, undamaged commercial parts.
Steps:
1. (50 min) For each drive, sensor and pack check part number, serial, visible damage and connector type; weigh it.
2. (40 min) Photograph labels; tag and bag anything that does not match.
3. (20 min) Reconcile against the packing list and order.
Calculation or measurement: Measured vs datasheet mass (e.g. 1.42 kg per RobStride 04).
Completion checks:
Mismatches quarantined.
Masses recorded.
Nothing powered.

Title: Inspect fabricated parts and fixtures
Goal: Fabricated parts match the drawings.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Check material certificates and 3 critical dimensions per part with calipers.
2. (40 min) Fit-check mating parts and weigh each.
3. (20 min) Quarantine any non-conforming part.
Completion checks:
Each accepted part has an inspection record.
Defects quarantined.
Masses updated.
Outside help: If a critical dimension is out, ask the Day 199 reviewer whether it can be used. Get: written yes or no.

Title: Review physical readiness for sensors
Goal: Ready for Stage 2, or clearly blocked.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Check S1 accepted, G4 released, sensor parts accepted, bench space and calibration references available.
2. (40 min) Draft the Stage 2 permit with the reviewer named on Day 133.
3. (20 min) Export a website backup (Settings → Export progress JSON) into JacobsBaymax/evidence/backups/.
Completion checks:
S1 and G4 records exist.
Permit drafted.
Missing items listed as blockers.

Title: Review the sensor test permit
Goal: Start Stage 2 only under a signed low-energy permit.
Steps:
1. (40 min) Fill the permit: you as operator; bench setup with drives unpowered; sensor logic from a current-limited bench supply (≤ 24 V, ≤ 1 A); procedure; calibrated references.
2. (40 min) List every channel to check: 10 joint encoders, 1 IMU, 8 foot load cells, drive current and temperature channels.
3. (20 min) Get the reviewer's signature and save the scan in JacobsBaymax/tests/permits/.
Completion checks:
Permit signed and saved.
Channel list complete.
Calibration references listed with dates.
Outside help: The reviewer named on Day 133 signs the stage permit. Get: signed permit naming the configuration, limits file hash and people.

Title: Verify position sensor readings
Goal: Each joint encoder reads the right angle in the right direction.
Steps:
1. (50 min) With drives unpowered, turn each output by hand to −0.5, 0, +0.5 rad against a digital angle gauge (±0.1°).
2. (40 min) Record encoder reading, gauge reading and sign for each point in a CSV.
3. (30 min) Power-cycle the logic and confirm each encoder reports the same zero within the permit tolerance.
Calculation or measurement: 10 joints × 3 angles = 30 points; error = reading − gauge (rad).
Completion checks:
30 points recorded; errors within the permit tolerance or logged as failures.
Every sign matches the register.
Zero recovers after power-cycle.

Title: Verify IMU and time behavior
Goal: The IMU frame and timestamps match what the controller expects.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Place the IMU on each of its 6 faces on a level surface; record the gravity vector for 10 s each.
2. (40 min) Log 60 s continuously and count timestamp gaps over 2 ms.
3. (20 min) Reboot the IMU and check the stream resumes with a fresh timestamp.
Calculation or measurement: |g| ≈ 9.81 m/s² on each face; sign matches x forward, y left, z up.
Completion checks:
All 6 faces give the expected axis and sign.
Gap count recorded.
Reboot behaviour recorded.

Title: Verify foot contact sensing
Goal: Foot load cells are calibrated with known weights.
Steps:
1. (50 min) On the restrained foot fixture, zero each cell, then load 5, 10 and 20 kg calibrated weights on it in turn.
2. (40 min) Fit a straight line per cell; compute the worst error as % of full scale.
3. (20 min) Note any saturation and the room temperature.
Calculation or measurement: References 49.05, 98.1, 196.2 N; acceptance ≤ 2% FS per the Day 116 protocol.
Completion checks:
8 cells calibrated or failures logged.
Fit error recorded per cell.
Raw data saved.

Title: Verify current and temperature logging
Goal: Current and temperature channels read correctly against references.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Pass 1, 2 and 5 A through a power resistor from the bench supply; compare the drive current channel with a clamp meter.
2. (40 min) Compare each temperature channel with a reference thermometer at room temperature and after 10 min of current.
3. (20 min) Write offsets and units in a CSV.
Completion checks:
Each channel identified and within tolerance, or REWORK.
Units recorded.
Second person present while powered.
Outside help: A second competent adult as stop operator, briefed on the e-stop and standing outside the fall zone. Get: their name and signature on the run sheet.

Title: Verify disconnect and stale signal behavior
Goal: An unplugged sensor shows 'unavailable', never a believable zero.
Steps:
1. (50 min) With drives unpowered, unplug one encoder, the IMU and one foot cell in turn.
2. (40 min) Measure how long the software takes to mark each as unavailable (target ≤ 100 ms, set in the permit).
3. (20 min) Confirm the state machine refuses enable while any channel is unavailable.
Completion checks:
Every disconnect detected, or logged as a blocker.
No fake healthy value shown.
Enable refused.

Title: Review and disposition stage S2
Goal: A real S2 decision on the sensor evidence.
Steps:
1. (40 min) Build the S2 evidence index: one line per run with run ID, file path, result, stops and calibration reference.
2. (40 min) Send the index to the reviewer. Record their decision (PASS / REWORK / BLOCKED), name, date and conditions in tests/stage records.
3. (30 min) Enter S2 on the website Reviews page with the signed record path.
Completion checks:
S2 is recorded only from the reviewer's decision.
Failed and stopped runs are in the index.
Conditions for the next stage are written.
Outside help: The reviewer named on Day 133 signs the stage permit. Get: signed permit naming the configuration, limits file hash and people.

Title: Review the actuator bench release
Goal: A signed permit before any drive gets power.
Steps:
1. (40 min) Fill the permit: knee drive with its 2:1 stage, clamped to the fixture; bench supply 48 V current-limited to 3 A; e-stop in the supply line.
2. (40 min) Record drive model, serial, firmware, limits file hash (±0.5 rad, 0.5 rad/s, 3 A), operator and stop operator.
3. (20 min) Get the reviewer's signature.
Completion checks:
Permit signed.
Stop operator named.
Limits hash recorded.
Outside help: The reviewer named on Day 133 signs the stage permit. Get: signed permit naming the configuration, limits file hash and people. A second competent adult as stop operator, briefed on the e-stop and standing outside the fall zone. Get: their name and signature on the run sheet.

Title: Inspect module installation deenergized
Goal: The drive is mounted exactly as drawn.
Steps:
1. (50 min) With power isolated, check bolt torques (mark each with paint pen), belt tension, connector seating and cable guards.
2. (40 min) Weigh the module with its stage and record.
3. (20 min) Photograph the installation for the record.
Completion checks:
All items pass or the module is held.
Mass recorded.
Power isolated throughout.

Title: Check identity and communications under permit
Goal: You are talking to the right drive and lost messages stop it.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Power logic only; read drive ID, firmware and units over CAN and compare with the register.
2. (40 min) Unplug the CAN cable; confirm the software refuses enable within 100 ms.
3. (20 min) Save the bus log.
Calculation or measurement: Response age (ms) before and after unplugging.
Completion checks:
ID unique and matches register.
Stale comms block enable.
Bus log saved.
Outside help: A second competent adult as stop operator, briefed on the e-stop and standing outside the fall zone. Get: their name and signature on the run sheet.

Title: Run the approved unloaded motion check
Goal: Bounded unloaded motion inside the permit limits.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Run the permit trajectory: 0 → +0.5 → −0.5 → 0 rad at 0.5 rad/s, three times.
2. (40 min) Log position, speed, current and temperature at ≥ 200 Hz.
3. (20 min) Compute max tracking error and peak current.
Completion checks:
All samples inside the permit limits.
Any stop recorded with time and cause.
Stop operator present.
Outside help: A second competent adult as stop operator, briefed on the e-stop and standing outside the fall zone. Get: their name and signature on the run sheet.

Title: Check approved module fault behavior
Goal: The drive stops when commands vanish or the e-stop is pressed.
Steps:
1. (50 min) During slow motion, press the e-stop 5 times and kill the command stream 5 times.
2. (40 min) Measure time from trigger to zero speed using the 1 kHz logger.
3. (20 min) Check that reset alone does not restart motion.
Calculation or measurement: 10 trials; report max stop time vs the permit value.
Completion checks:
All 10 within the permit value.
Reset never restarts motion.
Times measured, not estimated.
Outside help: A second competent adult as stop operator, briefed on the e-stop and standing outside the fall zone. Get: their name and signature on the run sheet.

Title: Assess module duty and temperature evidence
Goal: Check the knee drive stays cool under one gait cycle's load.
Steps:
1. (50 min) If the permit allows: hang the lever load giving 51.7 N m and run the Day 109 knee profile 3 times.
2. (40 min) Log winding or case temperature; compute rise per cycle.
3. (20 min) If not permitted, analyse the unloaded logs and write what load test is still needed.
Completion checks:
The tested load and duration are stated exactly.
Temperature rise recorded.
Untested conditions listed.
Outside help: A second competent adult as stop operator, briefed on the e-stop and standing outside the fall zone. Get: their name and signature on the run sheet.

Title: Review and disposition stage S3
Goal: A real S3 decision on the single-drive evidence.
Steps:
1. (40 min) Build the S3 evidence index: one line per run with run ID, file path, result, stops and calibration reference.
2. (40 min) Send the index to the reviewer. Record their decision (PASS / REWORK / BLOCKED), name, date and conditions in tests/stage records.
3. (30 min) Write what S3 does not cover (other joints, full leg, continuous duty).
Completion checks:
S3 is recorded only from the reviewer's decision.
Failed and stopped runs are in the index.
Conditions for the next stage are written.
Outside help: The reviewer named on Day 133 signs the stage permit. Get: signed permit naming the configuration, limits file hash and people.

Title: Review the electrical test release
Goal: A signed electrical permit before the pack is connected.
Steps:
1. (40 min) Check the pack and charger match the design: 13s, 54.6 V full, BMS model, fuse rating set by the electrical reviewer.
2. (40 min) Fill the permit: operator, instruments (multimeter, clamp meter), isolation steps, fault tests allowed.
3. (20 min) Get the electrical reviewer's signature.
Calculation or measurement: Voltage margin to drive max: 60 − 54.6 = 5.4 V.
Completion checks:
Permit signed.
Pack matches the design.
Stop conditions listed.
Outside help: Electrical reviewer from Day 126. Get: signed electrical test permit.

Title: Inspect distribution deenergized
Goal: The wiring matches the drawings before power.
Steps:
1. (50 min) With the pack disconnected, check fuse ratings, contactor model, polarity, wire gauges and connector types against the drawing.
2. (40 min) Measure continuity and insulation between DC+ and chassis with the multimeter.
3. (20 min) Tag any non-conforming item.
Completion checks:
Exact revision inspected.
Faults block energising.
Results recorded.
Outside help: Electrical reviewer or a qualified technician to witness. Get: their initials on the checklist.

Title: Verify approved startup and isolation
Goal: Power comes up only in the designed order.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Connect the pack; close the main switch; watch precharge and then contactor closure with motors inhibited.
2. (40 min) Record bus voltage, aux voltages and precharge time.
3. (20 min) Open the e-stop; confirm the contactor opens and the bus discharges as designed.
Completion checks:
Startup order matches the design.
No drive enables.
Readings logged.
Outside help: A second competent adult as stop operator, briefed on the e-stop and standing outside the fall zone. Get: their name and signature on the run sheet.

Title: Verify protected auxiliary loads
Goal: Computer and sensors run steadily from the pack.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Run the computer and all sensors from the pack for 30 min; log current, voltage and DC-DC temperature every 10 s.
2. (40 min) Compare average power with the Day 121 estimate.
3. (20 min) Note any droop below the converter's minimum input.
Completion checks:
30 min log saved.
Within limits.
Differences explained.
Outside help: A second competent adult as stop operator, briefed on the e-stop and standing outside the fall zone. Get: their name and signature on the run sheet.

Title: Review regen and protection behavior
Goal: Evidence that braking energy and faults are handled.
Steps:
1. (50 min) With the reviewer, back-drive one restrained drive and watch bus voltage; confirm the bleeder or BMS limits it below 60 V.
2. (40 min) For short-circuit and over-current protection, use vendor test data instead of testing.
3. (20 min) Record which cases were tested and which rely on vendor data.
Completion checks:
Each protection case evidenced or a blocker.
No short-circuit test performed.
Sources recorded.
Outside help: Electrical reviewer present.

Title: Check charging and service controls
Goal: Charging follows the pack manual.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Charge on a non-flammable surface per the manual; log time, voltage and temperature.
2. (40 min) Practise the service isolation steps: switch off, remove pack plug, wait the stated time, measure bus = 0 V.
3. (20 min) Fill the Day 125 procedure with the real values.
Completion checks:
Manual followed.
Isolation verified with a meter.
Procedure completed.

Title: Review and disposition stage S4
Goal: A real S4 decision on the power system.
Steps:
1. (40 min) Build the S4 evidence index: one line per run with run ID, file path, result, stops and calibration reference.
2. (40 min) Send the index to the reviewer. Record their decision (PASS / REWORK / BLOCKED), name, date and conditions in tests/stage records.
3. (30 min) Update the power model and hazards JB-H-04 and JB-H-17 with measured values.
Completion checks:
S4 is recorded only from the reviewer's decision.
Failed and stopped runs are in the index.
Conditions for the next stage are written.
Outside help: The reviewer named on Day 133 signs the stage permit. Get: signed permit naming the configuration, limits file hash and people.

Title: Review the safety test permit
Goal: Stop-time limits are set before any safety test.
Steps:
1. (40 min) Confirm the reviewer's numbers: max stop time, retained-load method, fault list, logger at ≥ 1 kHz, reset procedure.
2. (40 min) Trace the wiring once more to confirm the computer and network are not in the stop path.
3. (20 min) Get the safety reviewer's signature.
Completion checks:
Permit signed.
Independence traced.
Criteria present.
Outside help: Safety reviewer from Day 129.

Title: Test local and operator emergency stops
Goal: Each e-stop removes drive power within the limit.
Steps:
1. (50 min) On the restrained rig, run a joint slowly and press the robot e-stop 5 times, then the hand-held e-stop 5 times.
2. (40 min) Measure trigger-to-contactor-open and trigger-to-zero-speed from the logger.
3. (20 min) Check the gravity load stays held by the fixture after each stop.
Completion checks:
All 10 within the limit.
Times measured.
Gravity load held.
Outside help: A second competent adult as stop operator, briefed on the e-stop and standing outside the fall zone. Get: their name and signature on the run sheet.

Title: Test watchdog and communication loss
Goal: Losing the computer stops motion through the independent path.
Steps:
1. (50 min) During slow motion: kill the controller process, unplug CAN, stop the conversation service — one at a time.
2. (40 min) Record what removed drive power and how fast.
3. (20 min) Confirm the conversation service stopping changes nothing in motion safety.
Completion checks:
No unbounded motion.
Independent path acted.
Logs saved.
Outside help: A second competent adult as stop operator, briefed on the e-stop and standing outside the fall zone. Get: their name and signature on the run sheet.

Title: Test restart and power loss behavior
Goal: Nothing restarts by itself.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Run: reset after e-stop, controller reboot, pack disconnect during motion.
2. (40 min) After each, confirm motion needs a separate enable and start.
3. (20 min) Confirm the fixture holds every load with power gone.
Completion checks:
No automatic restart.
Loads retained.
Logs saved.
Outside help: A second competent adult as stop operator, briefed on the e-stop and standing outside the fall zone. Get: their name and signature on the run sheet.

Title: Test invalid limits and forbidden requests
Goal: Bad limits and bypass requests are refused.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Try enable with: no limits file, a limits file with a wrong hash, a step request outside the skill list.
2. (40 min) Ask the conversation service to 'move the leg now'; confirm the gateway refuses.
3. (20 min) Save each denial message.
Completion checks:
All denied.
Denials saved.
No motion occurred.
Outside help: A second competent adult as stop operator, briefed on the e-stop and standing outside the fall zone. Get: their name and signature on the run sheet.

Title: Test handling and payload interlocks
Goal: Handling needs a secured robot; walking is refused with a payload.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Use switches or dummy signals for support-present and payload-present.
2. (40 min) Try all 4 combinations for walking enable and handling enable; fill the 2 × 2 table.
3. (20 min) Use an inert dummy weight, never a person or body part.
Calculation or measurement: 2 × 2 = 4 combinations; allowed: handling only with support present; walking only with no payload.
Completion checks:
Forbidden combinations denied.
Table saved.
Sensing limits documented.
Outside help: A second competent adult as stop operator, briefed on the e-stop and standing outside the fall zone. Get: their name and signature on the run sheet.

Title: Review and disposition stage S5
Goal: A real S5 decision on the stop and interlock functions.
Steps:
1. (40 min) Build the S5 evidence index: one line per run with run ID, file path, result, stops and calibration reference.
2. (40 min) Send the index to the reviewer. Record their decision (PASS / REWORK / BLOCKED), name, date and conditions in tests/stage records.
3. (30 min) Record the approved limits file hash that later stages must use.
Completion checks:
S5 is recorded only from the reviewer's decision.
Failed and stopped runs are in the index.
Conditions for the next stage are written.
Outside help: The reviewer named on Day 133 signs the stage permit. Get: signed permit naming the configuration, limits file hash and people.

Title: Review the one joint configuration
Goal: Every part of the one-joint test is named before it starts.
Steps:
1. (40 min) Fill the permit for the knee with its 2:1 stage on the leg fixture: drive serial, stage, fixture drawing, limits hash, load plan (up to 51.7 N m).
2. (40 min) Confirm the fixture holds the lever and weights with power off.
3. (20 min) Get the reviewer's signature and book the stop operator.
Calculation or measurement: Max planned test torque 51.7 N m.
Completion checks:
Permit names all parts.
Fixture holds loads unpowered.
People booked.
Outside help: The reviewer named on Day 133 signs the stage permit. Get: signed permit naming the configuration, limits file hash and people.

Title: Inspect the joint and load path
Goal: The joint is built as drawn.
Steps:
1. (50 min) With power isolated, check bearing preload, belt tension, fastener torque marks and alignment.
2. (40 min) Record results; any adjustment goes through the reviewer.
3. (20 min) Photograph the installed joint.
Completion checks:
Matches the drawing.
Nonconformances closed or held.
Photos saved.

Title: Verify bounded tracking
Goal: The joint follows commands with the right sign.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Run the unloaded reference: 0 → 0.7 rad knee bend → 0 at 0.5 rad/s, three times.
2. (40 min) Log command vs position; compute RMS tracking error.
3. (20 min) Check the soft limits stop motion before the hard stops.
Completion checks:
Error within the permit value.
No wrong-direction motion.
Logs saved.
Outside help: A second competent adult as stop operator, briefed on the e-stop and standing outside the fall zone. Get: their name and signature on the run sheet.

Title: Run the approved representative duty
Goal: The knee carries its gait load on the fixture.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Hang 10.5 kg at 0.5 m (51.7 N m) and run the Day 109 knee profile 3 times.
2. (40 min) Log current, speed and temperature.
3. (20 min) Compute temperature rise per cycle and extrapolate to 2 trials.
Completion checks:
Only the tested duty is claimed.
Temperatures logged.
Uncertainty stated.
Outside help: A second competent adult as stop operator, briefed on the e-stop and standing outside the fall zone. Get: their name and signature on the run sheet.

Title: Check fault response under the joint setup
Goal: Stops still work with the joint loaded.
Steps:
1. (50 min) With the load hung, repeat 3 e-stop and 3 watchdog stops.
2. (40 min) Compare stop times with S5.
3. (20 min) Note any coast or drop of the load.
Completion checks:
Within the limit.
No load drop.
Logs saved.
Outside help: A second competent adult as stop operator, briefed on the e-stop and standing outside the fall zone. Get: their name and signature on the run sheet.

Title: Inspect after the duty run
Goal: No damage is carried into the leg stage.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Isolate power and inspect for wear dust, loosened fasteners, belt damage and heat marks.
2. (40 min) Recheck torque marks and belt tension; weigh the joint.
3. (20 min) Quarantine anything changed.
Completion checks:
No unresolved damage.
Mass updated.
Findings recorded.

Title: Review and disposition stage S6
Goal: A real S6 decision on the single-joint evidence.
Steps:
1. (40 min) Build the S6 evidence index: one line per run with run ID, file path, result, stops and calibration reference.
2. (40 min) Send the index to the reviewer. Record their decision (PASS / REWORK / BLOCKED), name, date and conditions in tests/stage records.
3. (30 min) Write the limits the one-leg stage may use, based on what S6 showed.
Completion checks:
S6 is recorded only from the reviewer's decision.
Failed and stopped runs are in the index.
Conditions for the next stage are written.
Outside help: The reviewer named on Day 133 signs the stage permit. Get: signed permit naming the configuration, limits file hash and people.

Title: Review the one leg permit
Goal: A permit for five powered joints on the fixture.
Steps:
1. (40 min) Fill the permit: left leg, 5 drives (hip roll 3:1, knee 2:1, others direct), fixture, limits hash, cases.
2. (40 min) Review collision and cable-strain risks from Day 97 with the reviewer.
3. (20 min) Get the signature; book the stop operator.
Calculation or measurement: 5 joints; max test torques from Day 110.
Completion checks:
Permit complete and signed.
Collision risks reviewed.
People booked.
Outside help: The reviewer named on Day 133 signs the stage permit. Get: signed permit naming the configuration, limits file hash and people.

Title: Assemble and inspect through the qualified team
Goal: The leg is assembled from released parts with hold points checked.
Steps:
1. (60 min) Assemble the leg on the fixture following the drawings; stop at each hold point for the reviewer's check.
2. (40 min) Record serials, fastener torques and any deviation.
3. (20 min) Weigh the leg.
Completion checks:
Hold points signed.
Deviations recorded.
Mass recorded.
Outside help: Mechanical reviewer for hold-point checks. Get: initials at each hold point.

Title: Verify joint identity and directions
Goal: Five channels map to the five right joints.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Move one joint at a time by +0.1 rad and confirm the expected link moves in the expected direction.
2. (40 min) Record name, address, sign and zero for each.
3. (20 min) Fix any mismatch before any coupled motion.
Completion checks:
All names and signs match.
Mismatches fixed and rechecked.
Logs saved.
Outside help: A second competent adult as stop operator, briefed on the e-stop and standing outside the fall zone. Get: their name and signature on the run sheet.

Title: Run approved coupled leg motion
Goal: The leg moves through a swing shape safely.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Run the Day 163 swing trajectory slowed to 50% speed, then 100%.
2. (40 min) Watch for self-collision and cable strain; log all joints.
3. (20 min) Compare peak joint speeds with simulation.
Calculation or measurement: Peak joint speed measured vs simulated.
Completion checks:
Inside the permit envelope.
No collision.
Logs synchronised.
Outside help: A second competent adult as stop operator, briefed on the e-stop and standing outside the fall zone. Get: their name and signature on the run sheet.

Title: Assess leg duty and thermal behavior
Goal: Check hip roll (3:1) and knee (2:1) heat under load.
Steps:

1. (50 min) Place the object, pin it, and run one cycle.
2. (40 min) Log position, current, temperature and any force reading.
3. (20 min) Compare peak current with the limit and decide with the reviewer whether to run 10.
Completion checks:
Meets criteria, or the 10-cycle run is blocked.
Logs saved.
Stop operator present.
Outside help: A second competent adult as stop operator, briefed on the e-stop and standing outside the fall zone. Get: their name and signature on the run sheet.

Title: Run the ten repetition sequence
Goal: Ten complete cycles, every one recorded.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Run 10 cycles back to back.
2. (40 min) Label each cycle complete, stopped or failed using the Day 300 rules.
3. (20 min) Weigh the object again afterwards.
Completion checks:
10 complete cycles, or the actual count stated.
Robot stayed secured; walking disabled.
Raw logs saved.
Outside help: A second competent adult as stop operator, briefed on the e-stop and standing outside the fall zone. Get: their name and signature on the run sheet.

Title: Analyze handling duty and stop evidence
Goal: Per-cycle numbers for all ten handling cycles.
Steps:
1. (50 min) Tabulate per cycle: time, peak current, temperature, end-position error.
2. (40 min) Find the worst cycle and any trend (e.g. temperature climbing).
3. (20 min) Any limit excursion makes that cycle not complete until the reviewer decides.
Completion checks:
Each cycle traceable.
Worst case stated.
Saved.

Title: Inspect and review after load testing
Goal: No hidden damage after the load test.
Steps:

2. (40 min) Quarantine anything damaged.
3. (20 min) Send any partial-run questions to the reviewer.
Completion checks:
No unresolved defect.
Recorded.
Questions sent.

Title: Retest only the reviewed handling scope

3. (20 min) Keep all earlier failures in the index.
Completion checks:

Failures kept.
Mass stays 2 kg.
